Package org.apache.hadoop.yarn.server.resourcemanager.webapp.dao

Class ApplicationSubmissionContextInfo

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.yarn.server.resourcemanager.webapp.dao.ApplicationSubmissionContextInfo
public class ApplicationSubmissionContextInfo extends Object
Simple class to allow users to send information required to create an ApplicationSubmissionContext which can then be used to submit an app
